calculation.expression: (1 - close_t / rolling_max(close, 180, min_periods=120)) shifted by 1 session
calculation.description: Ranks tradable assets by lagged drawdown from their 180-session peak. Larger drawdown magnitude receives a higher contrarian rebound score; the one-session lag prevents lookahead.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across the full 2020-2035 sample and strengthening at 1-, 5-, 10-, and 20-session horizons; recent windows are materially positive. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
